Record Class SpinOffProviderSplitsDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.dto.SpinOffProviderSplitsDto
Record Components:
splits - splits the split connector reports within 10 days of the action date
splitsUnavailable - true when the split connector could not be read
providerSplitFactor - factor of the split on the action date, which GT drops; null without one
spinOffFactor - provider factor divided by the stored splits on the action date
historySourceIsSplitSource - true when history connector and URL equal split connector and URL
historyBasis - recorded history basis, null when no spin-off is recorded on the date
historyFactor - recorded history factor
historyBasisOrigin - how the recorded history basis was decided
historyConnector - history connector the recorded basis belongs to
historyUrlExtend - history URL extension the recorded basis belongs to
currentSource - true when the recorded basis belongs to the parent's current history source
storedStep - price step of the stored series on the action date
deliveredStep - price step of the series the history connector delivers now
public record SpinOffProviderSplitsDto(List<SpinOffProviderSplitsDto.ProviderSplit> splits, boolean splitsUnavailable, Double providerSplitFactor, Double spinOffFactor, boolean historySourceIsSplitSource, SpinOffHistoryBasis historyBasis, Double historyFactor, SpinOffHistoryBasisOrigin historyBasisOrigin, String historyConnector, String historyUrlExtend, boolean currentSource, SpinOffProviderSplitsDto.Step storedStep, SpinOffProviderSplitsDto.Step deliveredStep) extends Record
What the administrator needs to judge the provider split and the history basis of a spin-off.
